known_bugs.description: Collision resolver ignores component rotation when computing bounding boxes
known_bugs.check_instruction: After placement, verify no rotated components overlap in 3D view — rotated bounding boxes must be recomputed

known_bugs.description: No courtyard gap enforcement between adjacent components
known_bugs.check_instruction: Verify minimum 0.25mm gap between all courtyard polygons (IPC-7351B)

known_bugs.description: Changing package size (0402↔0805) destroys placement layout
known_bugs.check_instruction: After package size change, verify group cohesion and subcircuit patterns are preserved

known_bugs.description: Subcircuit patterns live in training scripts not framework code
known_bugs.check_instruction: Verify subcircuit layouts come from placement_optimizer.py, not post-placement scripts

known_bugs.description: Connector edge placement not enforced — connectors can be interior
known_bugs.check_instruction: Every connector (J*) must be within 5mm of nearest board edge

known_bugs.description: Grade A placement score does not guarantee visually good layout
known_bugs.check_instruction: Cross-reference numerical score with visual inspection — scores lie, renders are truth

patterns.description: Compliance scores can lie — 13/13 with 0 collisions means nothing if 3D render shows overlap
patterns.check_instruction: Cross-reference PROG collision count with FAB-CLEARANCE visual checks for every component

patterns.description: THT pin headers naturally sit 2-3mm above board surface — this is normal, not floating
patterns.check_instruction: For THT J* components with thru_hole pads, accept 2-3mm body-to-board gap as normal

patterns.description: KiCad stores footprint origin at pin 1, not at centroid — use pin_map.compute_centroid_offset()
patterns.check_instruction: All position comparisons must use centroid-based coordinates, not KiCad origin

patterns.description: 3D model alignment uses JLCPCB centroid offset, not pad-1-based — 2 weeks of wrong approach proved this
patterns.check_instruction: 3D model offset must be computed from -JLCPCB_centroid, NOT from pad 1 position

patterns.description: Edge-mount connectors (USB, RJ45, SD card) intentionally overhang board edge
patterns.check_instruction: For edge-mount connectors, up to 10mm overhang is normal — do not flag as body overhang violation

patterns.description: Decoupling distance must be measured pad-to-pin (edge-to-edge), NOT center-to-center
patterns.check_instruction: Use actual pad coordinates from .kicad_pcb for proximity checks — QFN-48 IC pins are 5mm+ from center

patterns.description: Switches may have duplicate pad numbers (e.g., 2x pad 1, 2x pad 2) — this is normal
patterns.check_instruction: For switch components (SW*), allow duplicate pad numbers
